rows: The order matters to me, so let me set it out. Meet my force, and keep your head while you do it.
First, I want to be sure of the order. Give me a match and I will show you I can run it.
Nobody has seen me work yet, and that worries me. I will not promise anything that puts a person at risk.
Let me take the plan in stages. The harder it gets, the simpler my ask becomes.
Leading a match is the step I have been working toward. Let me take the plan in stages.
I trim my message to one thing I need. Leading a match would tell me, and everyone else, what I am made of.
I want to decide the pace of a match and make it work.
I will compete hard but I will not try to hurt you. I would rather be slow and right.
Come at me with strength, and let us see your control.

I hate being counted out before the bell even rings. One step, then the next, then the rest.
I am not here to injure anyone on purpose. My demand shrinks to one point when it heats up.
Trust me with the lead and I will not waste it.
If you think I have not improved, come and test it.
I want a chance before people decide what I am. I want to win fairly, not to break anyone.
